item: The market CSV feed import reads the kill switch after a failed fetch, so a Stop inside a proxied request is offline, not the feed's failure (R320)
summary: import_feed classified a failed fetch from the error text alone; a Stop that landed inside a proxied request arrives as request error ... ('Connection aborted.', AirplaneModeError(...)), which the anchored match (R298) rightly refuses, so the feed was filed refused, retryable, and retried after a sleep in airplane mode. The switch is now read after the failed check: verdict offline, not retryable, one attempt, no sleep; a robots disallow stays the host's answer; the same failure with the switch clear is still the feed's. Tests cut through the real requests/urllib3 wrapping; removing the guard fails two of them.
